d: THE HOLLOW CIRCUIT #3 — Neon Keys. Olquis spots it first: a lantern burning cold blue, at the edge of Sector Nine rooftops. Starring Zyquisor (Qumar Delvex), Olquis (Galdine Vewen), Ullmir (Kasha Helmere), Brenka (Kelvex Helkem). Neon-row couriers who dive the city's ghost frequencies discover a signal that was never meant to be heard.
